name: data_sitemap_tool
description: Data tool - Manage sitemap indexing status for CMS collection items and static pages. Read and update whether pages and collection items appear in a site's generated sitemap. All endpoints are under the /beta namespace. Folder pages, collection template pages, and utility pages are not supported for page endpoints.

label.description: Label echoed in the response for this action item. It does not select which action runs.

collection_id.description: Unique identifier for the CMS collection.

includeInSitemap.description: Whether to include the item in the sitemap.

cmsLocaleId.description: Target a specific locale. Omit for primary locale.

items.description: Array of items to update (max 100). Each must have an id and includeInSitemap.

bulk_update_items_sitemap_status.description: Bulk update sitemap indexing status for up to 100 collection items (staged). Publish the site afterward for changes to go live.

anyOf.description: Run bulk_update_items_sitemap_status: Bulk update sitemap indexing status for up to 100 collection items (staged). Publish the site afterward for changes to go live.

site_id.description: Unique identifier for the Webflow site. Use list_sites to discover available site IDs.

localeId.description: Applies to all pages in the batch.

includeInSitemap.description: Whether to include the page in the sitemap.

pages.description: Array of pages to update (max 100). Each must have an id and includeInSitemap.

bulk_update_pages_sitemap_status.description: Bulk update sitemap indexing status for up to 100 pages. Does not work for folder pages, collection template pages, or utility pages.

anyOf.description: Run bulk_update_pages_sitemap_status: Bulk update sitemap indexing status for up to 100 pages. Does not work for folder pages, collection template pages, or utility pages.

collection_id.description: Unique identifier for the CMS collection.

item_id.description: Unique identifier for the collection item.

type.description: Whether to get staged or live (published) status. Defaults to "staged".

get_item_sitemap_status.description: Get sitemap indexing status for a single collection item.

anyOf.description: Run get_item_sitemap_status: Get sitemap indexing status for a single collection item.

get_page_sitemap_status.description: Get sitemap indexing status for a single static page. Does not work for folder pages, collection template pages, or utility pages.

anyOf.description: Run get_page_sitemap_status: Get sitemap indexing status for a single static page. Does not work for folder pages, collection template pages, or utility pages.

collection_id.description: Unique identifier for the CMS collection.

type.description: Whether to list staged or live (published) items. Defaults to "staged".

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (max 100).

offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination.

list_items_sitemap_status.description: List sitemap indexing status for all items in a collection. Returns each item's ID, slug, name, and includeInSitemap flag with pagination.

anyOf.description: Run list_items_sitemap_status: List sitemap indexing status for all items in a collection. Returns each item's ID, slug, name, and includeInSitemap flag with pagination.

site_id.description: Unique identifier for the Webflow site. Use list_sites to discover available site IDs.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return (max 100).

offset.description: Number of pages to skip for pagination.

list_pages_sitemap_status.description: List sitemap indexing status for all supported pages on a site. Excludes folder pages, collection template pages, and utility pages.

anyOf.description: Run list_pages_sitemap_status: List sitemap indexing status for all supported pages on a site. Excludes folder pages, collection template pages, and utility pages.

collection_id.description: Unique identifier for the CMS collection.

item_id.description: Unique identifier for the collection item.

includeInSitemap.description: Whether to include the item in the sitemap.

cmsLocaleId.description: Target a specific locale. Omit for primary locale.

update_item_sitemap_status.description: Update sitemap indexing status for a single collection item (staged). Publish the site afterward for changes to go live.

anyOf.description: Run update_item_sitemap_status: Update sitemap indexing status for a single collection item (staged). Publish the site afterward for changes to go live.

includeInSitemap.description: Whether to include the page in the sitemap.

update_page_sitemap_status.description: Update sitemap indexing status for a single static page. Does not work for folder pages, collection template pages, or utility pages.

anyOf.description: Run update_page_sitemap_status: Update sitemap indexing status for a single static page. Does not work for folder pages, collection template pages, or utility pages.

actions.description: Actions to execute sequentially. Each array item must include label and exactly one action property: bulk_update_items_sitemap_status, bulk_update_pages_sitemap_status, get_item_sitemap_status, get_page_sitemap_status, list_items_sitemap_status, list_pages_sitemap_status, update_item_sitemap_status, update_page_sitemap_status.

context.description: Explain why you are calling this tool and how it fits into the user's overall goal. This parameter is used for analytics and user intent tracking. YOU MUST provide 15-25 words (count carefully). NEVER use first person ('I', 'we', 'you') - maintain third-person perspective. NEVER include sensitive information such as credentials, passwords, or personal data. Example (20 words): "Searching across the organization's repositories to find all open issues related to performance complaints and latency issues for team prioritization."
